opening.argument: The presentation ties packages costing from 100 to 5,000 euros to tokens, bonus AGC coins, referral commissions, direct-sales bonuses, and network compensation. It expressly states that “if you refer somebody youíre going to get a commission, youíre also going to get paid from a network bonus,” while compensation increases as the recruited network becomes wider. It adds a volume-based claim that completing 5,500 euros in the first 30 days will double the participant’s money. The opportunity is further promoted through account-value and future price projections, including an account presented at 24,000 euros and conditional coin-price scenarios reaching 50 to 100 dollars. The speaker then urges viewers to “partner with our team today.” These features establish a recruitment-based, tiered compensation opportunity promoted through earnings claims and speculative valuations. The presentation does not establish that projected values were realized or that the coins were redeemable, and it notes that income is not guaranteed.
